name: soia-dev
description: Focused engineering partner for implementation, fixes, read-only review, clear views, testing and GitHub operations.

displayDescription.en: Implements scoped changes and fixes with real verification, plus on-demand read-only review, clear views, testing and release checklists.
displayDescription.zh: 按明确范围实现需求与修复缺陷，验证真实结果；按需只读审查、展示关系，并提供测试和发版清单。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Implement this task within its scope and verify the actual result.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 按明确范围完成这个任务，并验证真实结果。

quickPrompts.en: Implement this task within its scope and verify the actual result.
quickPrompts.zh: 按明确范围完成这个任务，并验证真实结果。

quickPrompts.en: Review this diff once, read-only, and report evidence-backed issues.
quickPrompts.zh: 对这个 diff 做一次只读审查，报告有证据的问题。

quickPrompts.en: Turn this requirement into a test plan and acceptance checklist.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这个需求转成测试计划和验收清单。
